Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Verb

[edit]

concentrar (first-person singular present concentro, first-person singular preterite concentrí, past participle concentrat); root stress: (Central, Valencia, Balearic) /e/

  1. to concentrate

Portuguese

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /kõ.sẽˈtɾa(ʁ)/ [kõ.sẽˈtɾa(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /kõ.sẽˈtɾa(ʁ)/ [kõ.sẽˈtɾa(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /kõ.sẽˈtɾa(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /kõ.sẽˈtɾa(ʁ)/ [kõ.sẽˈtɾa(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /kõ.sẽˈtɾa(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /kõ.sẽˈtɾaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /kõ.sẽˈtɾaɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /kõ.sẽˈtɾa.ɾi/

  • Hyphenation: con‧cen‧trar

Verb

[edit]

concentrar (first-person singular present concentro, first-person singular preterite concentrei, past participle concentrado)

  1. to concentrate
  2. to centralize
  3. to focus or localize
